operations.description: Conditional write. expected_updated_at is the updated_at of the row the caller read, or null to create a row that does not exist yet; if the current row differs (changed, deleted or created by someone else) the write is refused with 409 wholesale_price_conflict and nothing changes. Every write moves updated_at forward. The line group must be one of the platform's own line groups (404 reseller_not_found otherwise).

fields.name: expected_updated_at
fields.description: updated_at of the row the caller read; null = create.
